clue.text: Request sustained effort

definitions.meaning: a formal written request, as for a job or a permit
diligent, persistent hard work, as in a student praised for their diligence

explanation.surface: Someone asks for continued hard work.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal request to an employer or office, and also the steady diligence of someone who keeps at a task.

clue.text: Charge after a very long time

parts.note: post- is a prefix meaning after, as in postwar
an age is a very long time, as in 'I waited for ages'

explanation.surface: A fee finally levied after an endless wait.
explanation.definitionFit: The fee paid for sending a letter or parcel by mail is a charge.

clue.text: One lady, say, and another on ill-fated liner

indicators.note: say tells us to take the lady's name as it is spoken, keeping only its sound

parts.note: Lucy is a woman's name, standing for one lady
Tania is another woman's name, a second lady

explanation.surface: Two women are aboard a doomed ocean liner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' means the first lady's name counts only for its sound, so it is spelt as the liner's opening is. 'on' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cunard ship torpedoed by a German submarine in 1915 is the most famous doomed passenger vessel after the Titanic.

clue.text: Part of problematic lumpy cluster

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A troublesome bumpy patch forms a cluster.
explanation.definitionFit: A tight group of trees or plants growing together is a clump, so it is a synonym of cluster.

clue.text: I'm inapt playing drums

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters of I'm inapt are performed in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A clumsy percussionist confesses incompetence at the kettledrums.
explanation.definitionFit: Kettledrums in an orchestra go by this Italian plural name, so they are drums.

clue.text: Astride horse bolting towards the land

parts.note: a rider sitting astride a horse is on it

indicators.note: a horse bolting runs off wildly, so its letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A rider clings on as the horse runs off towards dry land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Astride' suggests sitting on a horse, and the horse is there too, but it is anagram fodder; 'bolting' scrambles it.
explanation.definitionFit: A wind blowing from the sea in to the coast is described this way: landward.

clue.text: Nothing to fear from battleship

indicators.note: to here means added on to, so the word for nothing is joined after the word for fear

parts.note: dread is great fear
nought is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A mighty warship gives its crew nothing to fear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nothing to fear' reads as reassurance, but 'to' means 'attached to': NOUGHT goes on the end of DREAD.
explanation.definitionFit: HMS Dreadnought of 1906 gave its name to a whole class of big-gun warships, a type of battleship.

clue.text: My robe bespattered during first stage

indicators.note: bespattered means splashed all over, so the letters of my robe are messed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's gown got splashed during the opening round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'during' is a link word; the answer is the noun 'first stage', as in an idea still in embryo.
explanation.definitionFit: An unborn creature in its earliest development is an embryo, so the word means the rudimentary beginning of anything.

clue.text: Drives round to see another ancient king

indicators.note: round means placed around, so the word for drives encloses the other piece

parts.note: rams means drives, as in rams a stake into the ground

indicators.note: another tells us to make another version of see, its letters reordered

explanation.surface: A motorist does a circuit to visit a second pharaoh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another ancient king' looks like the definition, but 'another' is the anagram signal (another version of 'see'), and 'to' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Several pharaohs of ancient Egypt bore this name, the most famous being the second, so it names an ancient monarch.

clue.text: Take off disguise to expose true nature

definitions.meaning: remove a mask or false face
reveal what someone really is, as when a spy is exposed

explanation.surface: Removing a costume reveals who someone really is.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally to remove a face covering, and figuratively to reveal a hidden identity or a fraud.

clue.text: Washing depends on it

parts.note: depends is read literally as hangs down from: the laundry hangs from it to dry

explanation.definitionFit: Laundry is pegged out to dry on a cord stretched across a garden, so the wet clothes hang from it.

clue.text: Level with bar seat that had been adjusted

indicators.note: adjusted means altered, so the letters of bar seat are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A stool at the pub counter was raised to the same height.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people side by side, keeping up with each other, are alongside; so the word means level with.

clue.text: Bird exercises with a loud low manoeuvre

parts.note: PE, physical education, is school exercises
f, forte, is the musical mark for loud

indicators.note: manoeuvre means move around, so the letters of low are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bird works out, with a deep raucous movement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bird' at the start invites a search for a small bird; the low cry of an owl lies scrambled in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The peacock and peahen together are a large pheasant species, so this is a kind of bird.

clue.text: Feature nothing inside loop

indicators.note: inside places the letter for nothing within the word for a facial feature

parts.note: the nose is a feature of the face
O, the figure zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: A design includes nothing within a circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A hangman's or lasso's running knot is a loop of rope that tightens.

clue.text: Met in turn to make food

indicators.note: to make says the letters of met in turn are worked into something new

explanation.surface: Two people met in rotation to cook a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' looks like the anagram signal, but it is part of the fodder; 'to make' does the rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Nourishment taken in by a living body is food in the broad sense.

clue.text: Widespread demonstration of public opinion in the main — an overwhelming surge

definitions.meaning: a huge popular outpouring, such as a landslide of support

definitions.text: in the main — an overwhelming surge
definitions.meaning: the main is the open sea, where a huge surge of water can overwhelm the coast

explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively a sudden massive outburst of popular feeling; literally a giant ocean wave, the main being an old word for the sea.

clue.text: Surreptitious junior worker

parts.note: under means lower in rank, junior, as in under-manager
a hand is a worker, as in a farm hand

explanation.surface: A sneaky trainee on the staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Deceitful or done secretly, so a sneaky method is surreptitious.

clue.text: After first of month the German winning goal

indicators.note: After places the number for first behind the month's abbreviation

parts.note: Dec is the abbreviation for December, a month
I is the Roman numeral one, first
der is the German masculine word for the

explanation.surface: A German scores the clincher early in the month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After first of month' suggests the start of a month, but 'After' puts I (one, first) behind DEC; 'of' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A deciding score that settles a match is the goal that wins it.

clue.text: Old European gently leaves another European perhaps

indicators.note: leaves means goes away, so the letter for gently is taken out

parts.note: a Prussian came from the former German state of Prussia
p, piano, is the musical mark for softly or gently

explanation.surface: A former continental slips quietly away, leaving another national behind.
explanation.walkthrough: PRUSSIA was a German kingdom dissolved after 1945, so a PRUSSIAN is an old European. 'perhaps' marks the definition as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Russia, which lies partly in Europe, is one example of a national of that continent.

clue.text: Cumbrian town loses side-walk

indicators.note: loses means drops, so the word side is removed from the town's name

parts.note: Ambleside is a town in Cumbria, in the English Lake District

explanation.surface: A Lake District town loses its pavement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'side-walk' looks like one word, a pavement, but it splits: 'side' is removed and 'walk' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A leisurely stroll is a slow, relaxed walk.

clue.text: Symbolic maths

parts.note: the branch of mathematics that uses letters and symbols to stand for unknown numbers

explanation.definitionFit: The branch of arithmetic generalised with letters like x and y standing for quantities.

clue.text: Suit to change into

definitions.meaning: to look good on someone, as a dress suits them
to turn into something else, as a caterpillar into a butterfly

explanation.surface: Someone changes into a suit.
explanation.definitionFit: A hat that flatters its wearer suits them, and a tadpole that grows into a frog turns into one.

clue.text: Drudge saying it cuts

parts.note: a hack is a drudge, someone doing dull work for hire
a saw is an old saying or proverb

explanation.surface: A drudge's proverb is that it cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine-toothed bow tool used to slice through metal is a tool that cuts.

clue.text: Faded colourless twig

indicators.note: faded suggests a letter of the colourless word has drifted to another place in it

parts.note: white is colourless, pale

explanation.surface: A pale, withered stick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Faded' moves the H of WHITE two places along, giving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pliable willow stem used for tying or basketry is a kind of twig.

clue.text: Record one short visit that's reasonable

parts.note: a log is a record, as in a ship's log
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: short means cut down, so the visit word loses its final letter

parts.note: to pay a call is to make a visit

explanation.surface: A diary entry notes one brief, sensible visit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' removes the last L of CALL, leaving CAL. 'that's' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Sound and rational, following sensibly from the facts, so the word means reasonable.

clue.text: Not under current control

parts.note: current is read as a flow of water: a boat floating loose, carried by the stream and steered by nobody

explanation.definitionFit: A boat cut loose from its moorings drifts at the mercy of tide and wind; figuratively, someone aimless and lost.

clue.text: Book in French containing white of egg

parts.note: an album is a book, for photos or stamps
en is French for in

explanation.surface: A French cookbook includes egg white.
explanation.walkthrough: 'containing' is a link word joining the wordplay to the definition, though it reads like a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The clear protein-rich part of an egg around the yolk goes by this name.

clue.text: Prize for the best tan? Third best

definitions.meaning: a playful reading: an award for the finest sun-tanned skin, bronze being a tan colour
the award given for third place in a competition

explanation.surface: A sunbathing contest awards third place.
explanation.definitionFit: The award for finishing third in the Olympics, and humorously a reward for a deep suntan.
